t: This is Battersea Park, about two hundred acres of green space on the south bank of the Thames, opposite Chelsea. It is in the London Borough of Wandsworth and opened in 1858. Florence Esdaile, who lived from 1849 to 1936, died here. The material I have does not say more about her or why she was at the park, so I will not guess. For now, enjoy the open space, which has been here for well over a century and a half.
